concepts.name: Shared Responsibility
concepts.what: The provider secures the cloud infrastructure. The customer secures data, identities, configuration, and applications.
concepts.use: Questions asking who owns patching, access, encryption, or data protection.
facts: Managed services shift more operational work to the provider.
Customer data and identity configuration remain customer responsibilities.
traps: Do not assign application access decisions to the cloud provider.

questions.q: Which cloud benefit lets a company add and remove resources as demand changes?
questions.explain: Elasticity is the ability to acquire and release resources as demand changes.

questions.q: Which controls should be used to protect administrator access? (Choose two.)
questions.explain: MFA and least privilege reduce the risk of unauthorized administrative access.
